verdict.rationale: Trigger.dev has a dedicated Realtime feature explicitly for streaming live run updates and data from background tasks to frontend/backend without polling, plus community confirmation of using hooks for returning progress updates to the UI during long-running AI calls. This directly matches the story of streaming step updates from a running workflow into a frontend as it executes. Missing for 10: explicit documented example of streaming raw model tokens (vs. general run/metadata updates) and independent hands-on verification of the realtime streaming feature specifically.
